rows.Synonyms:
• Coconut Ice (floribunda, Rumwood 2016)
• Coconut Ice (grandiflora, Kordes 2005)
• KO 05/2321-04
• KORallister
rows.ARS:
Pink blend Grandiflora.
Exhibition name: Roy McAllister
rows.Origin:
Bred by W. Kordes & Sons (Germany, 2005). Bred by Rumwood Nursery (United Kingdom, before 2016).
Introduced in South Africa by Ludwig's Roses in 2012 as 'Roy McAllister'.
Introduced in Australia by Treloar Roses in 2015 as 'Coconut Ice'.
Introduced in United Kingdom by Rumwood Nurseries & Garden Centre in circa 2016 as 'Coconut Ice'.
rows.Bloom: Pink, white reverse. Full (26-40 petals), in small clusters, cupped bloom form. Blooms in flushes throughout the season.
rows.Habit:
Upright. Dark green foliage.

Height: 4' to 5' (120 to 150cm).
rows.Parentage: If you know the parentage of this rose, or other details, please contact us.
